## What's new

- **Keep the date taken.** Cleaned photos stay in the right place in your gallery's timeline instead of jumping to "today".
- **Remove only the location.** Strip GPS but keep camera details and dates. Pick what goes with the chips on the home screen.
- **Find photos that give away where you were.** The gallery marks photos with a location and can show only those, so you can clean them all at once.
- **See what was removed.** Tap any photo in the results to compare what was removed with what was kept. Failed photos can be retried.
- **Safer Replace.** Originals can go to the system Trash, restorable for 30 days, instead of being overwritten.
- **Quicker access.** Long-press the app icon to clean your latest photo or screenshot, or add the "Clean photos" Quick Settings tile.
- **Smaller touches.** The gallery remembers your last album, "View" opens a saved photo, and a light vibration tells you when cleaning is done.
- Smoother return to the home screen after cleaning many photos at once.

## Which file to download

Not sure? Get **`exif-remover-v1.1.0-universal.apk`**. It works on every phone.

The other files are the same app, labelled by processor type: `arm64-v8a` for almost all phones from recent years, `armeabi-v7a` for older 32-bit phones, and `x86` / `x86_64` for emulators and Chromebooks. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lets you check that a download is intact.

Requires Android 11 or newer. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.
